brief.goal: a hand-cranked winch: a printed 120x80x6mm base with two 60mm-tall, 6mm-thick side plates; a crank shaft carrying a 15-tooth module-1.5 spur gear that drives a 45-tooth module-1.5 spur gear on a 30mm-diameter rope drum shaft (3:1 reduction); both shafts turn in 608 bearings in the side plates; a 60mm crank arm with a handle
brief.design: This should read as sturdy shop equipment. Edges get a modest 1 mm chamfer on the outside, and plates and bosses are thick and generous rather than skeletal. Round features are concentric and clean, with a slight fillet where bosses meet plates and where the handle meets the arm, and nothing is decorative.

winch-frame.title: Winch frame
winch-frame.spec: One printed frame: a 120x80x6 base plate with two 6 mm thick side plates standing 60 mm tall along its long edges. Each side plate has two round bearing bosses, one for the rope drum shaft and one for the crank shaft, both at the same height and spaced so the 15T and 45T module-1.5 gears mesh. The bosses stand proud of both faces of each plate so a 608 bearing seats fully with a shoulder behind it.

contract.name: Winch frame
contract.summary: Base plus two side plates in one print. Shaft axes run along y at x = -/+ centre_distance/2, z = axle_height above the underside. Bearing boss faces are at y = +/-29 (inner) and +/-45 (outer).

rope-drum.title: Rope drum
rope-drum.spec: A 30 mm diameter rope drum barrel with a flange at each end to keep the rope on, axis along z. It is pressed onto the drum shaft between the two inner bearing bosses of the frame, leaving room at each end for the shaft's retaining collar. Add a small radial hole through the barrel near one flange to tie off the rope.

contract.name: Rope drum
contract.summary: Flanged 30 mm barrel on the drum shaft, axis along local z; end faces at z = +/-length/2, short enough to leave a retaining collar's room at each frame boss.

crank-arm.title: Crank arm
crank-arm.spec: A crank arm with a round hub at the origin pressed onto the crank shaft, a flat arm reaching 60 mm along +x, and a cylindrical grip handle standing up along +z at the arm's tip, away from the frame. The hub's -z face sits against the frame's bearing boss.

contract.name: Crank arm
contract.summary: Hub on the crank shaft at the origin, hub face at z=0 facing -z; 60 mm arm along +x with a handle along +z at its tip.
